book.name: Apanll Chtarangu
book.title: Apanll chtarangu anu Apanll chtakchuri ashirangu anu

content: Ashiriya, na kamanchintspa yuwaatssha Apanll Apramarineetsi: Ashpari tputsirish wayumshiree tas ksupchinllinpa, tárangu anootsshita

Apramarini masachirini 99 taaramchu, anush yusur Apanll waanaatsi tuyamandayaru, Apramarineetsi tsiyatarangiya. Apramaa, Nuw waatatana Apanlli. Nuwamaricha kizpuri taaki. Ashirucha, shiysha wanasiriri taarashish taangcha; urutamari nuwaa kuki payungcha.

Amb ashkachush, shiyapa kapungunashapari chinachiniya. Shiyaam uru nuw kapung istachinlla. Shiyachich aranginasha chinllinish pzapanichinllinaya, tárangiya. Nuwaana shiyaa amikureemi kapung ínchinllpa.

Ashirucha, Apramarinshitini anoo mazinarangu, tutunlltayaru, much tsapush timuchachawu, mazinazinaw ashirangiya. Uru nuw shiyapa kapung chinakchuri, shiyamari chinllinish tsapurnasish ztaru tatsitchinllinaya.

Amb ashkachush, shiyaa surish ndushapari nimun tsurtaksin Apramaa táchinllinaya. Nimun shiyaa sureetsish, tsurtaksin Aprahamaa, tátshapsinaya, watam shiyamari chinllinish tsapurunas ztaru taachinllinawa.
Shiyamari chinllinish ayam kurakaamaw kinaksin, yaktash ksutchinlliniya. Mishat, ichingaroom tsapurunas tputs shiyaatsimari wapareempaz ashirusin ínachinllinaya.

Itaru, amb ashkachuri, shiyachcheetsimari chinllineetsish, ayamta nllurnureetstamtish kapung chinachima. Urutamari nuw shiyachchee chinllinish ksutkuri taachina. Amb ashkachuri, nuwaatsimari Apanllireemani ínachinllinaya.
Ashiriya, natum tputsish watsapun masarush taaratarshin ashiksha, itaru nuwsha nee Kanaana tsap shiyaam, chinllineemtamtish ashchiri panachinllpa. Chinllinish nee tsap urutamari amuytachinllinaya.
Mishat, shiyaa atashina; Shiysha nlluranureetsish kamaningcha. Nuwaa kuki urutamari payuchinllinapa, watam nuw shiyaa amikurtaranginawa.

Itaru, Apramaa, shiyshat chinllinitamtish, tputsiritamtish, yuw shaanshu taakana an ichingarusin nuwaa kuki tuminchinllinpa, yuwaa nuw kamachtakachi anootsi. Ashiri ichingaru tputs kamuzanur wayumshiree tas ktsupchinllinpa.
Wayumshir tas tspakamchu, kukurini anoo kturchinllinpa. Amb ashiramchusin, tputs ichingarusin yuwaa nuw shiyapa kapung chinakurini taakani anoo uwshtisin yasachinllinaya.

Na nimun iwaz ichingarus tputsiritamtish wipaa wayumshir tas kturchinllinpa. Uru nllur nllurtaramchu, anamunsha tuchip matayaru zar maramchu anush kturungtsa. Tunareewaatstaa nllurtakachu, m'chachureetstamtish, yuwaatstam kurikpa tputsee wip paxanxarangish anootstam, kturungtsa, atashina. Ashkachus, nutseetis yusur tapatsteeyaa atitaateesa, ndunshaparee. Anumun urutamari tputs yasayastanllinaya yuwaa nuw siyapa amikurtarangi anootsi, yuwaatstam nuw siyachchee uru ksutki anootstamtaya.
Itaru, yuw nllur nda wayumshiree tas ksuparangu an nda siyapa washunand taachinllinaya. Watam nuwaa kuki nda payuranganawa, tárangiya Apanll Apramarineetsi.
Ashiriya, anumunsha Apanll Apramaa: Na nimun iwaz ndushapari izanlleetsish tsurtakush, Saray táchsha. Na nimun izanlleetsish suru Saraa ísamangcha.

Nuw izanlleemish Saraam kizpur istamaam zandkina. Nimun izanllish iparinachiya. Anumunarisha tputs pzapanichinlliniya. Zapan yakat taachiya. Anchich nllurnur kizpur kurakaw taachinllinaya, tárangiya Apanlli Apramarineetsi.

Apramarinsha timucheeru, mangshuri chinayaru, starangiya. ¿Tamareeja tputsich wachinich 100 masachirich taaru iparinachich? Mishat, ¿tamareeja izanlli Sar masachirini 90 taaru iparinach? tárangiya Apramarini.
Itaru, Apanlleetssha: Apaa, ¿Ismaelazuwa, ashtachiwa? Ashiri Ismaelaam istangi, tárangiya Apramarini.
Itaru, Apanllsha: Uru izanlliritish Sara wip tatsipchiya. Tatsipkachu, Isaakaa suru ísamangcha. Uru nuw Isaakaam kapung istachima. Iparpatish Isaakpa kapung amikurtachima.
Itaru, ipareemish Ismaelaam istachtamparina. Ismaelchich pzapanichtampasinaya. Iparish Ismael 12 wip wanindachiya. Kizpur kurakanand taachinlliniya.
Itaru, kaapa Isaakaam kizpur istachima. Isaakpa kapung amikurtachina, Na nimun izanllish Sar minush masach Isaakaa tatsipchiya, tárangiya Apanlli.
Táyaru, Apanll Apramarineetsi mikeeru kasarangiya. Kasayaru, Apanll naatarangiya.

Apramarinsha anuritam Apanllee kuk tuminurangiya. Wipaa wayumshir tas kturarangiya. Ichingaru yuwaa kamuz nllurtaku anuwaa wayumshiree tas kturtarangiya, muchchureewa wipa. Yuwaa kurikpa muchchureem paxanxarangu anoowaatstam wayumshir tas ktururangiya. Apramarini waanaatstatam wayumshir tas ktururangitamta. Yuwari Apanll tárangu anuri kukoo tuminuranganaya. Anpuritam zar Apramarini wip Ismaelarini wayumshiree tas ktururangitamta. Anpur Apramarini masachirini 99 taarangiya. Anpuritam zar wipsha Ismael masachirini 13 taarangiya. Ashiriya, na kamaneena yuwaa Apanll Apramarinee: Tputsee wayumshir tas kturungtsa, tárangu anootsi.

footnotes.text: Yuwaa nish átu anootstam Tayaspatampani 7.5 tayusima kamankiya.
